pinTriggerSql: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_pin_draws_insert AFTER INSERT ON draws BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO r30r1_research_measure SELECT p.run_id,'SOURCE_CHANGED:draws:INSERT:'||NEW.issue||':'||(SELECT generation FROM r30_live_source_revision WHERE singleton=1),'INPUT_INVALIDATION',p.policy_hash,'ORIGINAL_CANONICAL_INPUT',p.from_ordinal,p.through_ordinal,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'{"reason":"CANONICAL_CORRECTION_OR_IN_RANGE_BACKFILL","table":"draws"}' FROM r30r1_analysis_run p WHERE (p.status='INPUT_DATASET_PINNED') AND ((CAST(julianday(substr(NEW.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(NEW.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_pin_draws_update AFTER UPDATE ON draws WHEN (NEW.issue IS NOT OLD.issue OR NEW.open_time IS NOT OLD.open_time OR NEW.dirty IS NOT OLD.dirty OR NEW.n1 IS NOT OLD.n1 OR NEW.n2 IS NOT OLD.n2 OR NEW.n3 IS NOT OLD.n3 OR NEW.n4 IS NOT OLD.n4 OR NEW.n5 IS NOT OLD.n5 OR NEW.n6 IS NOT OLD.n6 OR NEW.n7 IS NOT OLD.n7 OR NEW.n8 IS NOT OLD.n8 OR NEW.n9 IS NOT OLD.n9 OR NEW.n10 IS NOT OLD.n10) BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO r30r1_research_measure SELECT p.run_id,'SOURCE_CHANGED:draws:UPDATE:'||NEW.issue||':'||(SELECT generation FROM r30_live_source_revision WHERE singleton=1),'INPUT_INVALIDATION',p.policy_hash,'ORIGINAL_CANONICAL_INPUT',p.from_ordinal,p.through_ordinal,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'{"reason":"CANONICAL_CORRECTION_OR_IN_RANGE_BACKFILL","table":"draws"}' FROM r30r1_analysis_run p WHERE (p.status='INPUT_DATASET_PINNED' OR p.status='ONLINE_MODEL_ROLE_REGISTERED') AND ((CAST(julianday(substr(NEW.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(NEW.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal OR (CAST(julianday(substr(OLD.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(OLD.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(OLD.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(OLD.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_pin_r27_history_import_insert AFTER INSERT ON r27_history_import BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO r30r1_research_measure SELECT p.run_id,'SOURCE_CHANGED:r27_history_import:INSERT:'||NEW.issue||':'||(SELECT generation FROM r30_live_source_revision WHERE singleton=1),'INPUT_INVALIDATION',p.policy_hash,'ORIGINAL_CANONICAL_INPUT',p.from_ordinal,p.through_ordinal,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'{"reason":"CANONICAL_CORRECTION_OR_IN_RANGE_BACKFILL","table":"r27_history_import"}' FROM r30r1_analysis_run p WHERE (p.status='INPUT_DATASET_PINNED') AND ((CAST(julianday(substr(NEW.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(NEW.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_pin_r27_history_import_update AFTER UPDATE ON r27_history_import WHEN (NEW.issue IS NOT OLD.issue OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.numbers IS NOT OLD.numbers OR NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status) BEGIN INSERT OR IGNORE INTO r30r1_research_measure SELECT p.run_id,'SOURCE_CHANGED:r27_history_import:UPDATE:'||NEW.issue||':'||(SELECT generation FROM r30_live_source_revision WHERE singleton=1),'INPUT_INVALIDATION',p.policy_hash,'ORIGINAL_CANONICAL_INPUT',p.from_ordinal,p.through_ordinal,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'{"reason":"CANONICAL_CORRECTION_OR_IN_RANGE_BACKFILL","table":"r27_history_import"}' FROM r30r1_analysis_run p WHERE (p.status='INPUT_DATASET_PINNED' OR p.status='ONLINE_MODEL_ROLE_REGISTERED') AND ((CAST(julianday(substr(NEW.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(NEW.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(NEW.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal OR (CAST(julianday(substr(OLD.issue,1,4)||'-'||substr(OLD.issue,5,2)||'-'||substr(OLD.issue,7,2))-julianday('2020-01-01') AS INTEGER)*1440+CAST(substr(OLD.issue,9,4) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN p.from_ordinal AND p.through_ordinal); END
researchDdl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_analysis_run(run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,dataset_hash TEXT NOT NULL,policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('TRAIN','SELECT','ONLINE_RESEARCH','CONFIRM','FUTURE','SYNTHETIC')),source_commit TEXT NOT NULL,source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,from_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,through_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,CHECK(from_ordinal<=through_ordinal))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_research_measure(run_id TEXT NOT NULL,measure_key TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,parent_hash TEXT NOT NULL,block_id TEXT NOT NULL,from_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,to_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,evaluated_calendar_issues INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(evaluated_calendar_issues>=0),mean_gain REAL,lower95 REAL,upper95 REAL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(run_id,measure_key),FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES r30r1_analysis_run(run_id),CHECK(from_ordinal<=to_ordinal),CHECK(lower95 IS NULL OR upper95 IS NULL OR lower95<=upper95))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_proposal(proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,parent_hash TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('READY','CONSUMED','REJECTED','STALE')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES r30r1_analysis_run(run_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_consume(proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,child_policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL,source_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,consumer_version TEXT NOT NULL,receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL,consumed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(proposal_id) REFERENCES r30r1_proposal(proposal_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_chart_cache(view_id TEXT NOT NULL,frame_id TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(view_id,frame_id),FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES r30r1_analysis_run(run_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_task_progress(task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_version TEXT NOT NULL,work_unit TEXT NOT NULL,work_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL,known_latest INTEGER NOT NULL,pending INTEGER,oldest_pending_ordinal INTEGER,last_commit_clock_ordinal INTEGER,completed_input_ordinal INTEGER,fence INTEGER NOT NULL,session_id TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,artifact_identity TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK(work_cursor>=0 AND known_latest>=work_cursor),CHECK(pending IS NULL OR pending>=0))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_run_source ON r30r1_analysis_run(dataset_hash,source_revision,role,policy_hash)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_proposal_ready ON r30r1_proposal(state,created_at,proposal_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_measure_kind_key ON r30r1_research_measure(kind,measure_key,run_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_measure_parent ON r30r1_research_measure(parent_hash,kind,from_ordinal)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_chart_latest ON r30r1_chart_cache(view_id,updated_at DESC)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_collection_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON r30r1_analysis_run WHEN OLD.status='ONLINE_MODEL_ROLE_REGISTERED' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESEARCH_COLLECTION_CONTRACT_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_collection_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON r30r1_analysis_run WHEN OLD.status='ONLINE_MODEL_ROLE_REGISTERED' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESEARCH_COLLECTION_CONTRACT_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30r1_consume_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON r30r1_consume BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESEARCH_CONSUMPTION_IMMUTABLE'); END
sourceTriggerSql: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_draws_insert AFTER INSERT ON draws BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_draws_update AFTER UPDATE ON draws WHEN (NEW.issue IS NOT OLD.issue OR NEW.open_time IS NOT OLD.open_time OR NEW.dirty IS NOT OLD.dirty OR NEW.n1 IS NOT OLD.n1 OR NEW.n2 IS NOT OLD.n2 OR NEW.n3 IS NOT OLD.n3 OR NEW.n4 IS NOT OLD.n4 OR NEW.n5 IS NOT OLD.n5 OR NEW.n6 IS NOT OLD.n6 OR NEW.n7 IS NOT OLD.n7 OR NEW.n8 IS NOT OLD.n8 OR NEW.n9 IS NOT OLD.n9 OR NEW.n10 IS NOT OLD.n10) BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_draws_delete AFTER DELETE ON draws BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_r27_history_import_insert AFTER INSERT ON r27_history_import BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_r27_history_import_update AFTER UPDATE ON r27_history_import WHEN (NEW.issue IS NOT OLD.issue OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.numbers IS NOT OLD.numbers OR NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status) BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS r30_live_revision_r27_history_import_delete AFTER DELETE ON r27_history_import BEGIN UPDATE r30_live_source_revision SET generation=generation+1 WHERE singleton=1; END
